Junior Mobile Operations Admin - Good as an entry level role

We welcome you to apply to Scorechamps’ new and exciting job opportunity. 

The role combines work with mobile apps and online marketing. It offers an opportunity to gain experience in the entire mobile apps’ development and marketing life cycle – this includes setup and launch of new mobile apps, managing design processes, tracking and analytics, product optimization, and more. (no development knowledge is required).

 The role is good for beginners with a beginners set of skills, good for students seeking a 80%-100% role and are able to work in hybrid both from home or from our office in Herzliya.

If you’ve got a good technical approach, very detail oriented, not afraid to learn new skills – both guided and self-learned, and you bring a lot of passion to your work, then you might be a good fit for this role.

 Are you and the position a good fit?

  • You are willing to work a 80-100% position on an hourly basis.
  • You are willing to work from home and from our office in Herzliya.
  • You must be technically savvy – This means that you can find solutions and fix common tech problems.
  • Your English reading and writing skills are flawless.
  • You have basic to mid Excel skills: sorting, filtering, creating graphs etc’
  • You appreciate and understand good digital product design, and can explain it
  • You are extremely responsible and detailed oriented
  • You’re a smart, fast learner and hungry for success.

Advantages:

  • Advantage – Basic knowledge of Photoshop / illustrator / Figma
  • Advantage – Familiarity with some sort of coding language – if you’ve ever tried coding and found that you like it – good! – no need to know a specific language – just not be afraid of it.
  • Huge advantage – If you know your way around networks and have a good grasp of cybersecurity practices.

 About the role:

  • You will bring your awesome personality with all of your energy and ideas.
  • You will manage and launch new mobile apps (no need for development knowledge).
  • You will configure tracking accounts and links for new traffic sources.
  • You will create reports to better understand performance and conversion.
  • You will manage app code updates and submits (no prior knowledge needed)
  • You will write product descriptions in English.
  • You will conduct keyword analysis and research
  • You will manage freelance designers and developers via platforms such as freelancer.com or upworks.com

 About the company:

Scorechamps is an innovative marketing-tech company that helps international companies with digital products increase exposure to their mobile products by driving new, unreached before customers from mobile app stores to their brand.

 If you think you are a good fit to succeed in grow in this role, please email us your CV to – product@scorechamps.com or lironver@lvpjobs.com

Project Manager (Position Filled - Not Available)

You are welcome to present your nomination to this exciting job opportunity!

The role is good point to launch start your career, as a junior project manager with relatively beginner set of skills – Ideal for graduates or nearly graduated students for their first/second serious role in the High-tech industry.

Work is a mix of work from our offices in Herzliya and from home – considering these troubled times – but should be willing to work full time from the office when things get back to normal.

If you’re highly motivated got excellent organizational skills, are detail oriented, fast learner, a good time manager & strong execution skills – then you are a good fit for this role.

What you’ll be owning:

  • Manage the execution of App Production Pipeline through a team of freelancers.
    From HTML coders, Designers, Content writers and mobile developers.
  • Keep track of all processes and speed up execution
  • Recruit new freelancers as needed and manage work loads through the team.
  • Create clear status dashboards and communicate progress upwards and sideways
  • Be part of the product evolution and ideas.
  • Bring awesome ideas and energy with you – Must!

What you need for this role:

  • Very organized and good with creating and executing processes
  • Responsible, detail oriented, fast executor
  • Excellent English – verbal and written skills are a must!
  • Experience with managing and hiring freelancers on platforms like -Upworks, Freelancer.com, Fiverr etc – Big advantage
  • Experience with Trello, Gantt charts & Kanban work process – Big advantage
  • Excellent communication and people skills
  • Appreciate and understand good product design
  • When needed – willing to work flexible hours remotely to answer questions from international providers
  • Up to 2 years of experience in Project Management – Preferably in the tech industry – Big advantage

If you consider yourself smart and know how to self learn new things – Excellent!

If you think you are fit to do this role and learn through it – you’re welcome to apply at – product@scorechamps.com or lironver@lvpjobs.com

Apply here – good luck 🙂
